consumers: PRODUCT original player / escaped text views

routes.auth: current trusted_ui read-proof or owner-scoped driver; native_bridge forbidden
routes.response: immutable media/text bytes with original type and controlled Content-Length/Range

reference: ReviewPart.download_ref is this same-instance loopback URL with opaque :ref; server maps it to project/run/package/version/output+quality/producer attempt and real receipt, not a caller path
integrity: same current record + open FD regular-file identity + bytes/hash validation; Range uses existing guarded MEDIA download semantics and closes own FD on disconnect/416/error; no ready Delivery implied
lifecycle: GET never starts rendering/registers state; unavailable/expired reference reports error, never creates fake preview; unknown fields/body not accepted

errors.404: unknown or not owned or invalid public ref
errors.409: stored bytes/hash mismatch or scope superseded
errors.503: preview producer unavailable or transient resource failure

counting: one explicitly additional read route; do not count as original frozen31 or as asset-inventory four routes
